notes: Tell inside modern Jenin; entry relies on earlier descriptions, travellers and excavation summaries (tell largely gone by 1978); no plan. f2: Glock's excavation area was 'in the east of the tell' (part of site, so 'none' for pits). f5: Byzantine pits on the south-western side of the tell ('none'). f3: tomb type not stated as rock-cut, but nine niches blocked by slabs = kokhim-like, so cavity_with_opening true. f7: Robinson's fountain 'reservoir of stone' and Conder and Kitchener's 'large masonry reservoir' are the same feature; 'near the west side' is of the town, not the tell, so relative_to other. f8: 'ten by ten [paces]' > 3 m a side. f12: de Saulcy's arch may be a tunnel or chamber entrance; coded as pit with doubt. Not coded: group of springs at the north foot of the tell (springs, not pools), long stone trough, two dams in the valley, canal, aqueduct, public bath.
